BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.

2. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Doors.

5. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.

6. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.

7. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.

8. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.

11. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

13. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

14. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

15. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.

16. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Appropriate Technology in Building and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Scaffolding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Roof Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitary Appliances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Drainage Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
